name: recall_swallowed_exception
about: A payment failure is caught and turned into None, so callers can no longer tell a declined card from a successful charge.
diff:
diff --git a/payments.py b/payments.py
--- a/payments.py
+++ b/payments.py
@@ -1,2 +1,5 @@
 def charge(card, amount):
-    return gateway.charge(card, amount)
+    try:
+        return gateway.charge(card, amount)
+    except Exception:
+        return None

base_sources.payments.py:
def charge(card, amount):
    return gateway.charge(card, amount)
